summary: Scribble-to-object Flow carded from Fabio's spec. Bench-first: prove the graph in the node graph before any app wiring. Deliberately NO umbrella - the three existing flow umbrellas (MPI-552 LTX trio, MPI-560 community format, MPI-529 library v2) do not cover flow CONTENT, and Fabio wants that structure fixed in a separate session.

Planned. Model choice decided: base SDXL Realistic, any-of set over all five SDXL models via MPI-590 modelParams. Investigation found the bench half is much smaller than the brief assumed - scribble and canny already ship on every SDXL model behind one ControlNet-Union checkpoint switched by Input_Control_Net, so the flow drives an existing branch. Also carried in three MPI-454 findings (edit model for the blend pass, no feather, deferCommit is live) and flagged the stale umbrella note in brief.md.

todo -> doing. Bench pass started. Graph design settled from the node schemas on the 8188 bench: MpiMaskSquareBbox derives the square crop rect from the paint alpha, AIO_Preprocessor + SetUnionControlNetType give the scribble/canny pair off one ControlNet-Union loader, RemoveBackground emits the MASK directly, and the stitch is a plain ImageCompositeMasked at the recorded x,y - so InpaintCrop/StitchImproved is NOT the carrier.

Model swap proven POSITIVELY on two arms after Fabio installed ILL Anime. Same graph, only ckpt_name changed: both arms kept the watchtower geometry from the ControlNet hint, and rendered it as the checkpoints differ - photoreal timber on SDXL Realistic, cel-shaded Illustrious lineart on ILL Anime (mean abs diff 17.5/255, 57.5% of pixels differing, byte-identical False). The bench half is now complete bar Fabio's sign-off by eye. Also filed a new bench trap: a part-downloaded weight is listed in /object_info under its final name and dies in CheckpointLoaderSimple with a shape RuntimeError that reads like a corrupt model.

Handoff cc220246 adopted; bench half signed off, wiring is next. Blocked behind MPI-599 by design: the scribble graph wants an SDXL checkpoint slot and a Klein edit slot picked independently, which the single-slot any-of shape cannot express. Wiring resumes on the labelled-slot shape.

The `paint` step kind is BUILT and proven live - the app half is unblocked. MpiStepPaint mounts PaintManager + brushDab.js (the History paint tool's own layer and dab, no second brush) on a plain canvas stage, the same relationship MpiStepCrop has with CropManager, and binds through STEP_MEDIA returning the layer ALONE as an RGBA PNG at the SOURCE's natural size - not the layer's own working size, which is what would silently misplace the object on a photo over PAINT_MAX_EDGE 4096. Every mutation records into its own UndoStack per docs/masking-undo.md. ONE frame change was unavoidable and no handoff had seen it: the merged graph takes TWO images (Input_Image AND Input_Paint) while _deriveRunMedia could only REPLACE a role's media, so a paint step would have eaten the photo - a step may now declare `mediaRole` and the frame appends when that role is empty; omit it and crop's behaviour is byte-identical. Verified live in an isolated instance on :58669 (never the user's port): layer back at the source's 1200x800, undo restores a stroke to the pixel (19529 -> 32893 -> 19529), Clear and undo-after-Clear hold, the eraser's undo restores 25274 exactly, wheel sizing clamps 2..400, a fresh mount seeded with the value restores the identical drawing (Reuse), and an unpainted step reports null and derives no file. That last one leaves ONE obligation on the WIRING, silent when got wrong: with no drawing there is no Input_Paint file and MpiLoadImageFromPath runs on its baked authoring path, returning a confident wrong result. The frame cannot guard it - a null from STEP_MEDIA legitimately means 'nothing changed' for crop. Contract: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/paint-gizmo.md.

Paint step kind verified live in an isolated instance (not by inspection): opaque-pixel counts and alpha bboxes through stroke / undo / clear / eraser / reuse / empty, plus the derived file at 1200x800 and 42392 bytes. Numbers in validation.md. NOT verified: the flow itself, which does not exist yet, and mediaRole's append path, which needs a flow declaring two media roles.

The graph is REBUILT onto the measured LanPaint route - both comfy_workflows/raw/flow_scribble_object.json and its runtime twin, 70 nodes to 55. Deleted the whole-image Klein relight and the difference-mask repair tail (109-115, 120-126, 131-135, 143-145, 150-153); stage 1 (1-35, scribble to object to stamped stitch) and the Klein loaders 100-105 are untouched. The new stage 2 is ported from research/lanpaint/seamfix.py build(): node 35's stamped composite plus MpiBoxMask(Input_Box) -> MpiMaskSquareBbox(64) as context -> InpaintCropImproved -> cropped_mask -> GrowMaskWithBlur(expand -96, blur_radius 96), the f096 seam fix -> SetLatentNoiseMask; cropped_image -> 106 -> VAEEncode -> ReferenceLatent -> FluxGuidance(4.0) -> LanPaint_KSampler (4 steps, cfg 1.0, euler/simple, NumSteps 2, Image First, Image Inpainting) -> VAEDecode -> InpaintStitchImproved -> SaveImage. New ids 160-169. The flow gained its first stage-2 injection point, Input_Box, which is where the box step lands. Two handoff facts went stale within hours: LanPaint IS on the app engine at 48188 now, so the conversion took the normal engine-schema route rather than the bench; and the ComfyUI float-quantisation warning about raw/'s exact 12/255 and 40/255 thresholds is moot, because those ThresholdMask nodes went with the tail. Two deliberate deviations from build(), both declared in the parity script's ALLOW list rather than left implicit: LanPaint's seed is wired to Input_Seed (26) like the deleted RandomNoise was, and node 106 ImageScaleToTotalPixels survives because resolution_steps 16 snaps 1024 squared straight back, which is why session 8's norescale was byte-identical to base. NOT run live - GPU authorization expired with session 8, so the ported wiring has not executed once.

Graph rebuild verified structurally, no GPU. research/lanpaint/graph_parity.py imports seamfix and calls build(feather=96) in-process, then diffs the shipped twin node for node and input for input - PARITY OK, including the prompt asserted equal to BLEND_PHYSICS2 verbatim. Also: no orphan nodes (all 55 reachable from an OUTPUT node), LiteGraph link table and back-references consistent across 84 links, the relight tail is gone by census (ImageBlend 0, ThresholdMask 0, MaskComposite 0, CFGGuider 0, SamplerCustomAdvanced 0, RandomNoise 0), and the 10 workflow-reading tests pass at 53 assertions. Re-run graph_parity.py after ANY edit to this graph: a positionally shifted widgets_values entry is silent, the converter shifts every later value and ComfyUI still validates, and that check is the only thing that catches it. Still open: one live 16s bench run, which needs GPU authorization.

The rebuilt graph RUNS, and it runs identically. Fabio authorized the GPU; research/lanpaint/graph_liverun.py pulled stage 2 out of the shipped twin itself rather than a hand-copy, fed it the stamped plates seamfix used on the same auto box at seed 134002004938138, and got mean abs 0.0 - max 0, 0 px differ - against session 8's f096 outputs on BOTH sun and overcast. 24.1s cold, 16.0s warm, against session 8's 16.1s. Confirmed a second way offline with ImageChops.difference().getbbox() returning None on both pairs. ONE TRAP WORTH KEEPING: gate this comparison on PIXELS, never on bytes. ComfyUI bakes the dispatched prompt into a PNG tEXt chunk, so two files holding the same picture hash differently the moment node ids differ, which they do here by construction - the first run reported DIFFERS on the sha alone and that read as a failure it was not. Stage 1 was deliberately not re-run: nodes 1-35 are untouched by this rebuild and were proven on the bench in session 7. The graph half of MPI-567 is now closed; what is left is the app wiring.

The app half is WIRED. flowScribbleObject registered in all four op files at appVersionIntroduced 1.5.0 (matching the four sibling flow ops in this dev cycle, not the released APP_VERSION 1.4.2), and the scribble-object FlowDef added to flowsRegistry.js. TWO choosable model slots at Fabio's instruction: Render model over all five SDXL ids, Blend model over klein-4b and klein-9b, resolving independently. THE BLEND SLOT SWAPS TWO NODES, and finding that was the real work: 9B needs qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot and 4B needs qwen_3_4b, the mismatch dies with a shape error that reads as a LanPaint bug, and node 100's CLIPLoader was UNTITLED - so it was retitled Input_Edit_Clip and each Klein arm now carries both weights. Its param must be the DOTTED Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name: clip_name is not on comfyController._inject's spray list while ckpt_name and unet_name are, so a plain key matches the node and writes nothing. The steps are paint (role image1, mediaRole image2, so the drawing does not eat the photo) and box (param box1 through the headSwap injector, no ratio, overflow allow). Two declared fields: an Input_Control_Net radio whose copy says TONAL not structured, and the mandatory Input_Control_strength slider at full 0-1 range, default 0.5. The no-drawing case turns out to fail CLOSED already, structurally: both MpiLoadImageFromPath loaders bake an empty string with block_if_empty true, which returns an ExecutionBlocker - now asserted, because it is a baked value nothing else defends. 683 tests pass; three new assertions in flow-model-choice.test.cjs, two of them mutation-checked red with the file restored byte-for-byte. STILL OPEN: no live run or reuse round trip yet, no tile or hero graphics, and the box step still defaults to the WHOLE IMAGE - the auto-seed from the drawing's bbox is designed but not built because it is a new shared-frame contract that wants Fabio's yes first.

Two fixes off Fabio's first look at the live picker. (1) BOTH Klein rows read 'FLUX.2 Klein' and could not be told apart - the two cards genuinely share a display name, and the prompt box solves it with a tier letter the Flow Library never rendered. The picker now appends that letter (9B = B, 4B = L), but ONLY when its own slot is ambiguous, so the five SDXL candidates stay bare. It uses a new ungated sizeTierLetter() rather than tierLetterFor(): the latter is install-gated, and this picker exists to choose BEFORE anything is installed, so the gate would blank the letter exactly when it is needed. One letter map still, tierLetterFor now sits on top of it. (2) The blend slot recommends klein-9b, not 4B - Fabio's call: 9B was judged better by eye on all five plates in session 7 and with the feather it matches 4B's seam numbers rather than trading them away, at ~1.9x the time. Declaration order IS preference order, so the list was reordered; note the recommendation and the BAKE now deliberately disagree, since the graph still loads 4B standing alone at the bench, and the 4B arm is what catches a re-export moving that default. 684 tests pass. One new test pins the disambiguation, mutation-checked twice: drop the letter -> RED, flip the recommendation back to 4B -> RED, files restored byte-for-byte. NOT asserted on purpose: that tierLetterFor is install-gated - it reads model.installed and the dep-status cache, neither of which a bare-Node harness stages, so it answers 'B' there and the assertion would be testing the harness rather than the code. The source check is what holds that line.

Fabio ran the flow end to end and reported nine things. FIVE are in shared flow-frame code, so at his instruction they were split into MPI-606 to run in a parallel session: flow inputs lost on navigation (s_flowInputs has ONE write site, inside _run, so nothing entered before Generate is ever persisted - affects EVERY flow), spacebar advancing a step (native <button> activation on the focused nav arrow, nobody wrote a handler), no arrow-key navigation (deliberately absent, his call overrides it), MpiColorPicker emitting a BARE ui:close-all-popups so opening the colour swatch takes the whole Flow overlay down and dumps the user on the gallery, and promptRequired being declared on fifteen-odd ops and read by nothing. Every root cause is traced to the line in MPI-606 plan.md. THE MISSING PROMPT WAS A BUG, NOT A MISSING FEATURE: this FlowDef declared positive: string inside inputSchema, and inputSchema.positive is read by NOTHING - the frame reads inputSchema.media and nothing else, and a prompt reaches the run by being a declared FIELD whose id is positive. So the flow shipped with no prompt box, Fabio drew a blob meaning an old lady and got an unidentifiable object rendered onto his tiger, and the dead key is what convinced a previous session the prompt was wired. Fixed by declaring positive on the paint step AND in the flow fields - one id, two surfaces, the shape character-sheet already uses - with the dead inputSchema key deleted and a comment saying why. The graph needed no change: node 17 Input_Positive already feeds a StringConcatenate that appends the isolate-on-white suffix before the encoder. Also ANSWERED not changed: the free-ratio box is correct, because the box wraps an object plus the ground its shadow falls on and the graph squares it at MpiMaskSquareBbox(64) anyway. Still needing Fabio: the op rename (unreleased, so free), brush types, the doodle on the box step, and hold-space pan.

Two 05-verify gates that were missing are closed, and both are mutation-checked rather than merely green. tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs had NO case for this flow - the flow with more titled injection points than any other, every one of which the injector skips SILENTLY. Added: input_image, input_paint, input_box, input_seed, input_control_net, input_control_strength, input_base_model, input_edit_model, input_edit_clip and output_image, plus a POSITIVE assertion that input_positive STAYS titled - the deliberate inverse of Outpaint and Head Swap, which leave their prompt node untitled precisely so the run cannot inject an empty string over a baked instruction. tests/flow-result-compare.test.cjs now pins compare: image1 for parity with its two siblings; the generic sweep already rejected a role the flow does not collect, but with one slot, deleting result outright was the only failure it could not see. Three mutants all RED and each named its own assertion: retitle Input_Positive, delete result.compare, break the paint step role. All three files restored byte-for-byte, verified by sha256 in a finally block, and comfy_workflows/ confirmed clean against HEAD afterwards. 686 tests pass, up from 684. NOT verified: anything live - no in-app run since the fix, which is what 05-verify.md Definition of Done still wants.

CORRECTION caught by reading before it shipped, not by a test. The prompt was first declared on BOTH the paint step and the flow-level fields - the shape character-sheet uses - and that silently drops edits from the SECOND run onward. A gizmo step keys its fields by role in _stepValues[role].fields; flow fields live in _fieldValues; _collectInputs applies the flow store LAST. Fresh open is harmless because _seedField returns undefined for a flow-level field with no default and no persisted root, so the key is absent. After one run s_flowInputs carries positive at the payload root, the flow-level copy seeds from it, and thereafter a prompt edited on the drawing step is overwritten at collection by the stale run-slide value - wrong picture, no error. character-sheet is NOT a counter-example: its prompt step is kind fields, a FRAME kind with no role whose values seed into the FLOW store by design, so it is one store. Reverted to a single declaration on the paint step. 686 tests still pass. Unifying the two stores is frame work and is logged as MPI-606 bug 6.
